name: voxbox-bus-tube-glue
description: Gentle Manley VOXBOX tube tone + PEAK CONTROL for a mix/2-bus or drum bus. Clean-ish LINE preamp (input 4 / gain 40 = subtle warmth, ~0.02% THD), a light ELOP optical leveling pass (comp_thresh 7, Medium/Medium), a broad passive Pultec 'smile' (lo_peak 3 @50 Hz + hi_peak 4 @16 kHz), and — the differentiator — the de-esser section switched to its 'Limit' position, which is a smooth opto LA-2A-style 10:1 WIDEBAND limiter catching stray peaks (crest 14.63 -> 12.76, RMS -17.7 -> -13.8 = +4 dB denser = real peak control, the opposite of the comp's crest-raising). A tasteful tube polish that tightens peaks without smashing.
intended_for: a mix bus / 2-bus / drum bus wanting subtle analog tube warmth + a low/high 'smile' + gentle peak taming before the dedicated mastering limiter. The CONTROL counterpart to voxbox-drum-glue (which opens transients); this one reins peaks in via the Limit mode.
plugin_build: UADx 'uaudio_manley_voxbox.vst3' (UADx NATIVE — RENDERS headless via Pedalboard 0.9.23; NOT the 'UAD Manley VOXBOX.component' passthrough twin). 25 params, all enums; the string switches (comp_byp/eq_byp/de_ess_byp=In, de_ess_sel='Limit', comp_attack/comp_rel, transformer_byp) MUST go through this setattr harness, not apply-vst-chain's float dict.
notes: THE 'Limit' POSITION of de_ess_sel is a smooth opto LA-2A-style WIDEBAND 10:1 limiter (program-dependent, ~2 ms attack / ~0.5 s release per Manley spec — NOT a fast brickwall), not a de-esser. Measured (vs de-ess byp): thr 2/5/8 pulled peak -0.25/-1.0/-3.6 dB and crest 14.7/14.1/12.9 — higher thr = more limiting. As shipped (full chain) it lands crest 14.63 -> 12.76 and RMS -17.7 -> -13.8 (denser, +4 dB). Use it for gentle, musical peak safety; it has NO true-peak/ceiling control so it is NOT a mastering brickwall — hand off to render-mastered or [[fabfilter-pro-l-2]] for the real limiter.
LINE mode is the cleaner path (Mic colours ~10-20 dB sooner). input 4 / gain 40 keeps THD low (~0.02%) for transparent warmth; push input/gain or switch to Mic for more colour.
PULTEC 'smile': lo_peak @50 for sub-weight + hi_peak @16k for air, both broad boost bells (0-10 nonlinear; ~+1.5/+1.0 dB at these settings). Keep amounts modest on a full mix.
The ELOP comp at comp_thresh 7 / Line / input 4 is gentle (a dB or two of optical leveling). On a 2-bus keep it light — the Limit mode is doing the peak work.
Harness peak-normalizes to -1 dBFS. For mastering-grade true-peak delivery, this is a tone/glue stage — follow with render-mastered / Pro-L 2.
Verify: crest DOWN (the Limit pulling peaks) + a gentle low/high lift + tiny THD rise. A 0.00 delta = the .component twin loaded.
